items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Rudy Vallee when he was in his prime and all that, this guy was Duke's bodyguard.

ctx.x: Honest to God, we played -- Oh, boy, there was some -- and from then on, when they was hotfooting,

all these big guys, you know, like, Rudy Vallee when he was in his prime and all that, this guy was Duke's bodyguard. He'd go get Duke from the theater with his machine gun between his legs, and they had a bulletproof glass.
Whom did Duke need protection from?
